messages:
maria_cs: Quick update — we've detected a partial onboarding failure impacting ~180 trial tenants who started imports between 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC and 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC. Some customers report missing documents and slow embeddings. Working group is triaging now.
kevin_pm: Thanks Maria. Do we have a shortlist of impacted customers and any renewal flags?
maria_cs: Pulling the list now, will share PII-free IDs. Early scan shows ~12 high-touch accounts (trial -> potential renewal in 30–60 days). Renewal risk score bumped for those.
ops_bot: Incident detected: onboarding_ingest_error v2.1 at 2026-03-19T02:04:11Z — rate limit on bulk-import lambda causing partial writes. Alert routed to eng-runtime.
nash: (joined) I'll take bulk-import path, will correlate logs.
nash: Found repeated 429s from our internal batch worker to ingest-service around 02:03–02:06 UTC. Looks like autoscale gap on dedup cache.
sam_eng: Working on a hotfix to increase retry window and add jitter. Deploy candidate in ~35m. ETA for deploy 03:40 UTC.
jake_support: For customers reporting missing docs, recommended immediate mitigation: 1) run a manual re-ingest via UI (retry button) or 2) ask us to queue a backfill job. I'll draft templated language for CS outreach.
maria_cs: Please attach the templated note. We want to split comms: (A) high-touch customers — personalized email + offer 2 weeks premium credits and guided office hours; (B) self-serve trials — broadcast note + retry instructions.
nash: Backfill queue stable once we throttle at 30rps to ingest-service. I'll open a controlled backfill run for affected tenant batch 001-060.
jake_support: Draft for self-serve: "We're aware of an onboarding upload disruption for a subset of trials on 3/18–3/19. You can retry ingestion in the app or reply and we'll schedule a backfill. We're offering a courtesy two-week credit for impacted trials." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
olivia_csm: For high-touch, add line offering a 1:1 migration session with an engineer during office hours. Also propose collecting a single sample doc to verify indexing post-backfill.
maria_cs: Good call Olivia. I'll put together the high-touch template and include RSVP link for office hours.
kevin_pm: Also capture renewal risk note for SDRs/AE — flag accounts that had active trials with >1000 docs ingested. We'll push to CRM tagged "onboard-incident-03-19".
ops_bot: Deployment started: hotfix/ingest-retries -> staging at 2026-03-19T03:05:12Z.
sam_eng: Hotfix pushed to prod at 03:41 UTC, increased retry window + added 10–50ms jitter. Monitoring shows ingestion success rates returning to baseline by 03:55 UTC.
jake_support: Manual backfills queued for first batch (IDs 001–060). Estimated run time 2h for that batch. I'll coordinate with CS before each tenant run.
maria_cs: Drafted two emails. Posting high-touch template below for review: 

---
maria_cs (high-touch email draft):
Hi <CustomerName>,

Wanted to reach personally — we saw an ingestion disruption during your onboarding window (3/18 18:00 UTC–3/19 02:00 UTC) which may have left some documents unindexed. We're scheduling a prioritized backfill and would like to offer a complimentary 1:1 session with our engineer to validate everything. We'll also add a 2-week credit to your account.

Please reply with a convenient time or click here to reserve a slot: https://redwood-inference.example/office-hours

Apologies for the disruption — we'll confirm once backfill finishes and share verification steps.
Best,
Maria (Customer Success)
---

ash: LGTM. Add a short tech line: "No change to your data integrity — documents were not lost; writes were delayed."
olivia_csm: Approve + add renewal outreach bullet for AE: "We will follow up post-backfill with a health summary and suggested next steps for launch."
maria_cs: OK finalizing. Plan timeline: 1) Send self-serve broadcast in 45m with retry instructions; 2) Start priority backfills now for batch 1; 3) Run office hours for high-touch tomorrow 14:00–17:00 PT; 4) Send personalized emails as backfills complete.
kevin_pm: Will notify sales ops and attach CRM tag. Also prepare a short exec note for product/leadership.
jake_support: Logging action items: (a) queue backfills and send per-tenant slack pings; (b) apply credits to impacted accounts; (c) publish KB article with retry steps and what to expect.
maria_cs: Shared customer list (PII removed): TENANT-001, TENANT-002, TENANT-003, TENANT-004, TENANT-005, TENANT-006, TENANT-007, TENANT-008, TENANT-009, TENANT-010, TENANT-011, TENANT-012, plus ~168 self-serve trials.
sam_eng: Current status: ingestion success rate 99.8% post-fix. No data loss detected. Continuing to monitor for 24h.
maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll post final customer broadcast in 40m and ping the channel when sent. If anyone has objections to the credit offer, speak now. :thumbsup:
kevin_pm: :thumbsup:
olivia_csm: :thumbsup:
jake_support: :thumbsup:
